recognize_zh: 流式細胞圖中紅色族群側向散射（SSC）偏高、CD33 強陽性、CD117 陽性、CD13 陽性，但 HLA-DR 與 CD34 陰性，細胞內 MPO 陽性、TdT 陰性，這種 CD34−/HLA-DR− 的高 SSC 骨髓系族群是 APL 的典型免疫表型。
features: Abnormal population (red) with dim-moderate CD45 and high side scatter
Bright homogeneous CD33 and CD117 positive; CD13 positive with heterogeneous intensity
HLA-DR negative and CD34 negative; CD7 negative
CD15 expression on a subset within the CD117+ gate (80.75% of events in gate B); CD64 dim on a separate subset, CD14 negative
Cytoplasmic MPO positive; cytoplasmic CD79a, cytoplasmic CD3 and TdT negative
describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis shows a dominant abnormal myeloid population with dim-to-moderate CD45 and high side scatter. The cells are CD33 bright, CD117 positive, CD13 positive with heterogeneous intensity and partial CD15, while negative for HLA-DR, CD34, CD7 and CD14; CD64 is dim on a subset. Intracellular staining shows myeloperoxidase positivity with negative cytoplasmic CD79a, cytoplasmic CD3 and TdT, excluding B-, T- and lymphoblastic lineage. This CD34-negative, HLA-DR-negative, high-SSC myeloid phenotype is characteristic of abnormal promyelocytes and, together with morphology, is suggestive of acute promyelocytic leukemia; PML::RARA confirmation is required.

ddx.vs: Also frequently CD34-negative and HLA-DR-negative, but usually has lower side scatter, monocytic markers more often, and lacks PML::RARA.
Normal promyelocytes are CD34-/HLA-DR- but show a synchronous CD13/CD16/CD11b maturation pattern with high CD15, rather than a homogeneous CD33-bright arrested population.
Separation is not possible by this panel alone; genetic testing for PML::RARA is decisive.
